hero.caption: The main building of the Falstad complex in Nord-Trøndelag, Norway. Built as part of a boarding school for boys in the 1920s, the building was part of Falstad concentration camp during the Second World War. Since the 1990s the building has been a museum.
hero.alt: The main building of the Falstad complex in Nord-Trøndelag, Norway. Built as part of a boarding school for boys in the 1920s, the building was part of Falstad concentration camp during the Second World War. Since the 1990s the building has been a museum.

images.filename: Bak fangebrakkene - Behind the prisoner barracks (6276311970).jpg
images.caption:
Området bak (sør for) fangebrakkene på Falstad. Bildet er trolig tatt i 1945, sannsynligvis etter frigjøringen. Gjennom bildet går det doble gjerdet. I bakgrunnen skimtes også inngangen til en potetkjeller sørvest for leirområdet.
The area behind (south of) the prisoner barracks at Falstad. The picture is probably taken in 1945, after liberation. The double fence runs through the picture. In the backgrund is the enterance to a potato cellar south-west of the camp area.
Dato/Date: 1945?
Fotograf/Photographer:  Ukjent/Unknown
Sted/Place: Ekne, Nord-Trøndelag, Norge/Norway

images.caption:
Ekne offentlige skole (tidligere Falstad leir) sett fra lufta i 1953. De fleste bygningene fra krigsåra er revet, og hovedbygningen har gjennomgått en større ombygging. Fortsatt vises sporene etter fangebrakkene, murgolvet i vaskebrakka og noe av fundamentet til vaktbrakka.
Ekne offentlige skole (school in  the prison camp at Falstad) seen from above in 1953. Most of the buildings from WW2 are removed and the main building has been rebuilt. The "footprints" of the prisoner barracks are still visible, aswell as the floor of the sanitary barrack and parts of the foundation of the guard barrack.
Dato/Date: 1953
Fotograf/Photographer: Ukjent/Unknown
Sted/Place: Ekne, Nord-Trøndelag, Norge/Norway

Arkivreferanse/Archive reference: FSM foto 0800152

images.caption:
Falstad sett fra det vestligste vakttårnet, trolig umiddelbart etter frigjøringen i mai 1945. Fortsatt står det "Strafgefangenenlager" over porten, men "SS" mangler. Bygningen foran til venstre er politbrakka (vaktbrakka). Ved porten skimtes også skinnegangen som gikk gjennom leirområdet.
Falstad seen from the western guard tower, probably just after Liberation in May 1945. Above the gate it says "Strafgefangenenlager", but "SS" has been removed. The building to the left is the guard barrack. By the gate we see parts of the rail track through the camp area.
Dato/Date: 1945
Fotograf/Photographer: Ukjent/Unknown
Sted/Place: Ekne, Nord-Trøndelag, Norge/Norway
